provenance.scope: AI-authored synthetic English context-free intent challenge, not independent or user-tested.
provenance.excluded: No slot accuracy, multi-turn execution, cloud LLM, bank quote, student study or financial outcome is measured.
provenance.review_process: Gold labels authored before first run, not altered to match outputs. No training or threshold adjustment on these cases.
